reason: A opens with the failed first campaign and answers my doubt directly: all-or-nothing refunds, $36,000 already pledged so only $49,000 is left, a named chair, quarterly spending reports, and honest caveats about the roof cost and new releases. B buries last time, leaves placeholders for the name, and gives me no refund guarantee, so I'd hesitate to pledge after already giving $200 elsewhere.
